E1.question: At equal tokens and updates, on the same fresh seeds and the same evaluation data, how does AP-Q - AR-ref change as training tokens grow? Where does the sign flip?

hypotheses.H-E1a: Delta = BPB(AP-Q) - BPB(AR-ref) increases monotonically with training tokens.
hypotheses.H-E1b: At 88.6M tokens with equal updates (676), Delta <= 0: AP-Q is at least as good when exposure is matched at the discovery scale. If Delta > 0 already at 88.6M, AP-Q's fixed-time advantage came entirely from extra exposure.

alternatives: seed-set effect: ruled in or out by using fresh seeds 6-8 for every cell
schedule-variable effect: the 300 s cell versus the 157.3M cell for AP-Q (similar token count) and versus the 88.6M cell for AR-ref (similar update count)
E1.design: 2 recipes x 4 cells (88,604,672 / 157,286,400 / 201,326,592 tokens and 300 s fixed time) x seeds 6, 7, 8 = 24 runs
held_constant: LR progress = token fraction (fixed-time cell: time fraction, as in the frozen source)
token stream (prefix of the verified stream)
E1.order_design: Seed blocks 6, 7, 8. Within a block the budget order is a cyclic Latin square (seed 6: 88.6M, 157.3M, 201.3M, 300 s; seed 7: 157.3M, 201.3M, 300 s, 88.6M; seed 8: 201.3M, 300 s, 88.6M, 157.3M). The two recipes of a (budget, seed) pair run back to back so paired runs share GPU conditions; the first recipe alternates from pair to pair (each recipe leads 6 of 12 pairs).
E1.decode: not measured (optional in the source plan; deterministic in architecture and already measured)
E1.precondition: E0 verdict PASS under this plan's sha256

analysis_plan.delta: BPB(AP-Q) - BPB(AR-ref), paired by seed within a cell
analysis_plan.metric_choice_rationale: held-out BPB is the Phase-1 panel's primary quality metric; validation BPB (same evaluator) is reported in full; the 300 s comparison with the seeds 0-2 result uses in-process validation BPB, the quantity behind -0.0067
analysis_plan.interval: t-based: mean +/- t(0.975, n-1) x sd / sqrt(n); n = 3 -> t = 4.3027
analysis_plan.crossover: zero crossing of the piecewise-linear mean Delta curve over x = ln(tokens) at the three token budgets (linear interpolation between adjacent budgets whose mean Deltas differ in sign); 'none in range' with the curve's sign otherwise

bootstrap.unit: seed; each resampled seed carries its full Delta curve (all three budgets); only seeds with all three token cells complete enter
reported: fraction of resamples whose mean curve crosses zero inside [88.6M, 201.3M]
2.5/50/97.5 percentiles of the first crossing (conditional on crossing)

decision_rules.cell_category: AP-Q_better if CI upper < 0; AR-ref_better if CI lower > 0; approximately_zero if the CI includes 0 and |mean| < 0.005; otherwise inconclusive
decision_rules.H_E1a: supported if the three mean Deltas are strictly increasing in tokens AND the per-seed contrast Delta(201.3M) - Delta(88.6M) has CI lower > 0; contradicted if that contrast's CI upper < 0; otherwise inconclusive
decision_rules.H_E1b: on Delta(88.6M): supported if AP-Q_better; not rejected if approximately_zero, or inconclusive with mean <= 0; contradicted if AR-ref_better

outcome_table.crossover: Delta(88.6M) is AP-Q_better and Delta(201.3M) is AR-ref_better -> 'AP-Q is better below about X M tokens and worse above' (X from the mean-curve crossover)
outcome_table.exposure_explains_fixed_time_advantage: Delta(88.6M) is approximately_zero or AR-ref_better -> 'the fixed-time advantage is explained by extra exposure'

decision_rules.schedule_effect: detected if the per-seed difference BPB(recipe, 300 s) - BPB(recipe, matched token cell) has a CI excluding 0 and |mean| > 0.005; token counts of the 300 s runs are reported alongside because they are not equal to the token cell
decision_rules.fixed_time_vs_history: Welch 95% CI for mean Delta(300 s, seeds 6-8) - mean Delta(300 s, seeds 0-2): consistent if it includes 0, differs otherwise; also report whether the seeds 6-8 CI contains -0.0067

historical_fixed_time.sources: SNAPDB confirmation_runs 13-15 (exp 291-293, AP-Q, seeds 0-2) vs 7-9 (exp 75-77, AR-ref, seeds 0-2); audit/camera_ready_2026/05 section 1.2

analysis_plan.missing_data: Only runs that passed their integrity gates enter. A failed pair drops that seed from that cell (n < 3 is reported); the crossover bootstrap uses seeds with all three token cells. No imputation, no outlier deletion.

deviations_and_operational_choices: Primary E1 metric is held-out BPB (the panel's primary); 08 does not name one. Validation BPB is reported in full.
E0 run 2 uses an update window of [669, 681] instead of literal equality: fixed-time update counts are throughput outcomes.
A data identity gate (training shards, tokenizer, 1,536-microbatch stream hash) runs first in E0 to operationalize P2; training still reads the cache, not the network.
The fixed-time cell uses the c200ccb launcher for both recipes; AR-ref's historical runs used the 86cafb0 launcher, which differs only by post-run contract validation.
The fixed-time cell uses a minimal isolate and per-run compile caches instead of a whole-repository copy and the shared default compile cache.
Token cells reuse run_one/evaluate_one, which evaluate all four milestones; this costs evaluation time but leaves the evaluator invocation unchanged.
The A40-hour estimate is revised upward from 08 (see cost_estimate).
